description.en: Mr Tyson's workshop: the workbench, the hammer and the nails, the boards and the saw, the sawdust, the tools on the wall, the broom, the rake and the wheelbarrow, Alfie's wooden horse and the glue that mends it, and a basket of bobbins from the old bobbin mill.
description.sl: Delavnica gospoda Tysona: delovna miza, kladivo in žeblji, deske in žaga, žagovina, orodje na steni, metla, grablje in samokolnica, Alfiejev leseni konjiček in lepilo, ki ga popravi, ter košara vretenc iz stare tovarne vretenc.
description.it: Il laboratorio del signor Tyson: il banco da lavoro, il martello e i chiodi, le assi e la sega, la segatura, gli attrezzi sul muro, la scopa, il rastrello e la carriola, il cavallino di legno di Alfie e la colla che lo aggiusta, e un cesto di rocchetti del vecchio mulino dei rocchetti.
description.de: Herr Tysons Werkstatt: die Werkbank, der Hammer und die Nägel, die Bretter und die Säge, das Sägemehl, das Werkzeug an der Wand, der Besen, der Rechen und die Schubkarre, Alfies Holzpferd und der Leim, der es repariert, und ein Korb Spulen aus der alten Spulenfabrik.

words.example_en: Mr Tyson mends things in his workshop.
words.example_sl: Gospod Tyson v svoji delavnici popravlja stvari.
words.example_it: Il signor Tyson aggiusta le cose nel suo laboratorio.
words.example_de: Herr Tyson repariert Sachen in seiner Werkstatt.
words.note: A workshop is a room for making and mending things with tools.
words.note_sl: Workshop je prostor, kjer z orodjem izdeluješ in popravljaš stvari.
words.note_it: Il workshop è una stanza dove si fanno e si aggiustano cose con gli attrezzi.
words.note_de: Ein workshop ist ein Raum, in dem man mit Werkzeug Dinge baut und repariert.

words.example_en: The hammer is on the workbench.
words.example_it: Il martello è sul banco da lavoro.
words.example_de: Der Hammer liegt auf der Werkbank.
words.note: A workbench is a strong table for working with wood. Work + bench.
words.note_sl: Workbench je trdna miza za delo z lesom. Work + bench.
words.note_it: Il workbench è un tavolo robusto per lavorare il legno. Work + bench.
words.note_de: Eine workbench ist ein stabiler Tisch für die Arbeit mit Holz. Work + bench.

words.note: You hit a nail with a hammer. Bang!
words.note_sl: S hammer udariš po žeblju. Bum!
words.note_it: Con l'hammer batti sul chiodo. Bang!
words.note_de: Mit dem hammer schlägst du auf den Nagel. Peng!

words.example_en: I need ten nails for the gate.
words.example_it: Mi servono dieci chiodi per il cancello.
words.example_de: Ich brauche zehn Nägel für das Gatter.
words.note: A nail goes into wood. Your nails are on your fingers, too!
words.note_sl: Nail gre v les. Tudi nohti na prstih so nails!
words.note_it: Il nail va nel legno. Anche le unghie delle dita sono nails!
words.note_de: Ein nail geht ins Holz. Auch deine Fingernägel sind nails!

words.example_en: This board is too long. Let's saw it.
words.example_sl: Ta deska je predolga. Prežagajva jo.
words.example_de: Dieses Brett ist zu lang. Sägen wir es ab.
words.note: A board is a long, flat piece of wood. A blackboard is for chalk!
words.note_sl: Board je dolg, ploščat kos lesa. Blackboard pa je šolska tabla!
words.note_it: Il board è un pezzo di legno lungo e piatto. La blackboard è la lavagna!
words.note_de: Ein board ist ein langes, flaches Stück Holz. Ein blackboard ist die Tafel!

words.example_en: The saw hangs on the wall over the workbench.
words.example_sl: Žaga visi na steni nad delovno mizo.
words.example_it: La sega è appesa al muro sopra il banco.
words.example_de: Die Säge hängt an der Wand über der Werkbank.
words.note: A saw has sharp teeth. To saw: to cut wood with a saw. Saw is also the past of see!
words.note_sl: Saw ima ostre zobe. To saw: žagati. Saw je tudi pretekli čas od see (videti)!
words.note_it: La saw ha i denti affilati. To saw: segare. Saw è anche il passato di see (vedere)!
words.note_de: Eine saw hat scharfe Zähne. To saw: sägen. Saw ist auch die Vergangenheit von see (sehen)!

words.example_en: There's sawdust everywhere! Get the broom.
words.example_it: C'è segatura dappertutto! Prendi la scopa.
words.example_de: Überall ist Sägemehl! Hol den Besen.
words.note: Sawdust is like flour made of wood. You can't count it: some sawdust, a lot of sawdust.
words.note_sl: Sawdust je kot moka iz lesa. Ne moreš je šteti: some sawdust, a lot of sawdust.
words.note_it: Il sawdust è come una farina di legno. Non si conta: some sawdust, a lot of sawdust.
words.note_de: Sawdust ist wie Mehl aus Holz. Man kann es nicht zählen: some sawdust, a lot of sawdust.

words.example_en: Mr Tyson's tools hang on the wall.
words.example_sl: Orodje gospoda Tysona visi na steni.
words.example_it: Gli attrezzi del signor Tyson sono appesi al muro.
words.example_de: Herr Tysons Werkzeug hängt an der Wand.
words.note: One tool, two tools. A hammer, a saw and a spade are all tools.
words.note_sl: One tool, two tools. Kladivo, žaga in lopata so vse tools.
words.note_it: One tool, two tools. Il martello, la sega e la vanga sono tutti tools.
words.note_de: One tool, two tools. Hammer, Säge und Spaten sind alles tools.

words.example_en: Alfie sweeps the floor with the broom.
words.example_it: Alfie spazza il pavimento con la scopa.
words.example_de: Alfie fegt den Boden mit dem Besen.
words.note: Sweep the floor with a broom. A witch flies on one!
words.note_sl: Sweep the floor: pometati tla z metlo. Čarovnica na njej leti!
words.note_it: Sweep the floor: spazzare il pavimento con la scopa. La strega ci vola sopra!
words.note_de: Sweep the floor: den Boden mit dem Besen fegen. Eine Hexe fliegt darauf!

words.example_en: The rake stands next to the broom.
words.example_it: Il rastrello è vicino alla scopa.
words.example_de: Der Rechen steht neben dem Besen.
words.note: You rake leaves and hay together with a rake.
words.note_sl: Z rake (grabljami) zgrabiš listje in seno.
words.note_it: Con il rake si raccolgono le foglie e il fieno.
words.note_de: Mit dem rake recht man Laub und Heu zusammen.

words.example_en: Put the stones in the wheelbarrow.
words.example_de: Leg die Steine in die Schubkarre.
words.note: A wheelbarrow has one wheel and two handles. Wheel + barrow.
words.note_sl: Wheelbarrow ima eno kolo in dva ročaja. Wheel + barrow.
words.note_it: La wheelbarrow ha una ruota e due manici. Wheel + barrow.
words.note_de: Eine wheelbarrow hat ein Rad und zwei Griffe. Wheel + barrow.

words.example_en: Mr Tyson made Alfie a wooden horse.
words.example_sl: Gospod Tyson je Alfieju naredil lesenega konjička.
words.example_it: Il signor Tyson ha fatto ad Alfie un cavallino di legno.
words.example_de: Herr Tyson hat Alfie ein Holzpferd gemacht.
words.note: Wooden: made of wood. A wooden horse, a wooden spoon, a wooden box.
words.note_sl: Wooden: lesen. A wooden horse, a wooden spoon (lesena žlica), a wooden box.
words.note_it: Wooden: di legno. A wooden horse, a wooden spoon (cucchiaio di legno), a wooden box.
words.note_de: Wooden: aus Holz. A wooden horse, a wooden spoon (Holzlöffel), a wooden box.

words.example_en: A bit of glue, and the horse is as good as new.
words.example_sl: Malo lepila in konjiček je kot nov.
words.example_it: Un po' di colla, e il cavallino è come nuovo.
words.example_de: Ein bisschen Leim, und das Pferd ist wie neu.
words.note: To glue: to stick two things together. Wait until the glue is dry!
words.note_sl: To glue: zlepiti dve stvari. Počakaj, da se glue posuši!
words.note_it: To glue: incollare due cose. Aspetta che la glue si asciughi!
words.note_de: To glue: zwei Dinge zusammenkleben. Warte, bis der glue trocken ist!

words.example_en: There's a basket of old bobbins by the broom.
words.example_sl: Ob metli je košara starih vretenc.
words.example_it: Vicino alla scopa c'è un cesto di vecchi rocchetti.
words.example_de: Neben dem Besen steht ein Korb mit alten Spulen.
words.note: Thread goes round a bobbin. The Lake District's mills made millions of them from its woods.
words.note_sl: Nit se navija na bobbin. Mlini v Lake Districtu so jih iz domačega lesa naredili na milijone.
words.note_it: Il filo si avvolge sul bobbin. I mulini del Lake District ne facevano milioni con il legno dei boschi.
words.note_de: Garn wird auf eine bobbin gewickelt. Die Mühlen im Lake District machten Millionen davon aus dem Holz der Wälder.
